description: One red circle on a tile: the smallest usual note.
A note on an item, on row 3 (index 2), on the Unranked tray and on the frame, with strokes in red, blue and contrast. The row note has two strokes: the second starts where the first ended.
Points left of and above their anchor, steps longer than 31 grid units (the wide form), a dot of one point, and a step of no length.
Item ids with the marks of the format, spaces, an address, letters outside ASCII, and the longest id an anchor takes (256 characters). Row 100 (index 99) is the last row an anchor takes.
A usual recording: 150 points, circles on tiles and a few words beside the list.
A pen drawn to its end: 500 points, circles on tiles and words beside the list.
